The fund-level company-worker test is stated as proven fact (the fund's customer ID is looked up in Gen_companyworker). In the fund SQL the subquery is `from Gen_companyworker where gen_customeridnumber = Gen_identitynumber` with unqualified columns. SQL Server binds an unqualified column to the innermost FROM first. gen_fundmain does have gen_customeridnumber, but no supplied file shows the columns of Gen_companyworker (it appears only in 0022). If Gen_companyworker had its own gen_customeridnumber, the subquery would be uncorrelated (all funds or none). The package's own finding#5 marks this link as 'לא מאומת'. This text contradicts it. Fix: present the fund-level link as an assumption (for example 'בהנחה ש-gen_customeridnumber בתת-השאילתה הוא של gen_fundmain; ראו ממצא 5'). The FT-request test (cw.gen_identitynumber = ft.Gen_identitynumber) is fully qualified and proven.
